row: A search that asks other engines. Samia wonders who actually answers.
sticker.back: What it is: Presearch, a metasearch: community computers pass your question to existing search sources. What you hold: nothing; a browser is enough. What you give up: not every trace; logs may include an IP address. The wrong idea: free money for searching. Rewards are optional, in a token, under terms. Named as an example, not a recommendation. Checked 2026-11-23.
sticker.line: The list of pages, followed back to where it came from.
